examples.trans: She was the first plan all along.
I have been waiting for you the whole time.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!
You think you are professional now?

meanings.note: Adverb yě placed strictly before the verb.

examples.trans: This is also a good thing.

meanings.note: Noun shū; in 念书 it means formal study in school.

examples.trans: Studied in school for a few years.

meanings.note: Particle le marking completion after a verb or a new situation at the end of a sentence.
Verb yǐwéi, nearly always implying the assumption turned out wrong.

examples.text: 你以为你能做这个节目吗？
examples.trans: Do you think you can make this show?
I thought you had already left.
We need to do the initial artist selection.
Even more accurate than my data.

meanings.note: Indefinite small number jǐ ('several') in statements.

examples.trans: I studied for a few years.
How many questions do you have?
I am going to the office tomorrow.

meanings.note: Sentence-final particle ma turning a statement into a yes-no question.
Final particle ba softening suggestions ('let's') or seeking confirmation ('right?').

examples.trans: Do not treat employees like pawns.
The company has many new staff.

meanings.note: Determiner nǎ ('which') or assimilated final particle na after -n in 天哪.
Noun tiān; 我的天哪 exclaims 'oh my goodness!'.
Reduplicated noun tiāntiān functioning adverbially before the verb.

examples.trans: Your teacher praises you every day.
She stays up late every day lately.

meanings.note: Exclamatory degree adverb tài, typically paired with 了.

examples.trans: The evidence was way too obvious.
You push yourself way too hard!
Your teacher praises you every day, right?
Everyone praises her for being conscientious.

meanings.note: Adverb jiù marking immediacy, 'just/merely', or a direct consequence.

examples.trans: If nobody wants her, she stays.

meanings.note: Used both as noun ('job / work') and verb ('to work'), canonical pos noun.

examples.trans: Do you want this job or not?
She works in the chief editor's office.

meanings.note: Time measure word nián ('year'), used directly after numbers without 个.

examples.trans: I have worked for three years.

meanings.note: Verb dāng; in 把 X 当 Y, 'treat X as Y'.

examples.trans: Do not treat staff as pawns.
I treat you as a good friend.

meanings.note: Particle de introducing a degree/manner complement (睡得不好), or verb děi ('must').
Verb niàn; 念书 means 'attend school / study'.
Question word zěnme asking 'how?' or 'what happened?'.

examples.trans: How did you think of it?
How did you think of it?
I did not think of this method.

meanings.note: Preposition bǎ placing a definite object ahead of the action and its result.

examples.trans: Drink up this cup of tea.
Do not treat staff as chess pieces.

meanings.note: Verb ná; 拿工资 means 'draw a salary'.

examples.trans: Please hold the folder for me.
Even more accurate than my data.

meanings.note: Noun qízǐ, used figuratively for a pawn in someone's scheme.

examples.trans: I do not want to be someone's pawn.
Every piece on the board matters.

meanings.note: Comparison marker bǐ in A 比 B + adjective.

examples.trans: Your plan is more accurate than mine.
I want to make TV shows.
All the hard work went to waste for nothing.
Do not miss the chance for nothing.

meanings.note: Structural particle de linking modifiers to nouns.

examples.trans: You watched last night's show, right?
Look, she released a new song!

meanings.note: Ordinal prefix 第 (dì) plus 一 (yī).
Respectful title lǎoshī for professors and senior industry colleagues.

examples.trans: Your teacher praises you every day, right?
Can you make television just like that?
Take care of your own health.
Do you want this job or not?
Wang Er has to take responsibility.
You think you are a professional now?
I think this plan is great.

examples.text: 你让我们的努力白白浪费了。
examples.trans: You made our hard work go to waste.
The teacher asked me to come tomorrow.
How did you think of inviting her?

meanings.note: Adverb hái ('still' in 还没; 'even more' in 还要).

examples.trans: The thesis is still not finished.
This show is great to watch.
Doing it this way is wrong.
So that is how it is.

meanings.note: Inclusive adverb dōu summarizing everything named before it.
